title: Web Designer - UX, UI, CMS
profile: UX/UI Designer with 2 years of industry experience designing responsive, user-friendly web and mobile experiences, supported by an MSc in Design Innovation from Maynooth University. Experienced in applying UX/UI design principles alongside visual design in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator, including marketing posters and graphics that supported branding and campaign outreach, and in user research, usability testing, wireframing, prototyping and high-fidelity UI design in Figma. Strong at working with stakeholders and developers to deliver digital projects across desktop and mobile while keeping designs consistent.
